layout.title: 115″ wall TV · 6-seat L clear of door and column · walnut-topped ottoman
notes: Main run 4″ off the west glass (shade clearance), y 34–143: 5″ south of the column’s legroom line, 1″ short of the balcony door.
Two main seats (31″) and the corner face the TV square on at 14 ft; three 34″ seats on the north return face the lake and see the TV over their left shoulder.
68″ × 34″ upholstered ottoman with a full-length rigid walnut top (the coffee-table footrest idea), 16″ from both seat fronts.
TV centered at y 59: 4.5″ of wall between its edge and the light-switch plate.

findings: All three: the right scheme for this room; no placement found that beats it.
Return seats still turn 43–63°; the nearest is 7′7″ from the screen at a 48° fill.
1″ to the balcony door and 2.2″ of legroom at the column are tighter than the traced measurements (grok, codex, sonnet).
The walnut-topped ottoman is a custom build, not a product (sonnet); a 76″ table would reach the east return seat (codex).
Rug edge 3″ past the sofa back (sonnet).
